stem: 电子商务平台固有的金融犯罪风险有哪些？（选择四项。）

options.A: 利用电子商务平台转移犯罪所得。
options.B: 使用被盗银行卡进行网上购物。
options.C: 易受欺诈手段影响的电子商务平台。
options.D: 电子商务平台被用作非法交易的幌子。
options.E: 电商平台鼓励不受监管的个人对个人借贷。

stem_en: Which financial crime risks are inherent to e-commerce platforms? (Select four.)

options_en.A: E-commerce platforms exploited to move criminal proceeds.
options_en.B: Use of stolen bank cards for online purchases.
options_en.C: E-commerce platforms susceptible to fraud schemes.
options_en.D: E-commerce platforms used as a front for illicit transactions.
options_en.E: E-commerce platforms encouraging unregulated peer-to-peer lending.
